sites.rationale: The ledger (PMID 10347183) explicitly names Pro-297 as the insertion site in the external loop between TM7 and TM8. Python confirms seq[296]='P' (position 297) and that position 297 falls within the computed extracellular span 289-307. residue_before=P (pos 297), residue_after=T (pos 298). Distance from TM7 end (288): 9 residues; distance from TM8 start (308): 11 residues — well clear of both TM boundaries. The 19-aa loop (289-307) is long enough to accommodate a ~15-23 aa tag. Function was measured and found largely preserved (minor effects only), making this the highest-confidence extracellular site. HA epitope tag inserted at Pro-297 in the extracellular loop between TM7 and TM8 (ECL 289-307) of full-length human SLC19A1 fused to C-terminal eGFP; expressed in mammalian cells and tested for methotrexate binding and uptake. The insertion had only minor effects on both methotrexate binding and uptake. [validation: surface_and_function; position: validated; source: paper; entailment_verified: True]

sources.claim: The hemagglutinin epitope insertion mutants were also tested for their effects on the function of the reduced folate carrier. For these studies, each of the constructs had a carboxyl-terminal fusion of the enhanced green fluorescent protein to monitor and quantitate expression. Insertions into the external loop between transmembrane regions 7 and 8 (Pro-297), the cytoplasmic loop between transmembrane regions 6 and 7 (Ser-225), and near the cytoplasmic amino and carboxyl termini (Pro-20 and Gly-492, respectively) had minor effects on methotrexate binding and uptake.

sites.rationale: The ledger (PMID 10347183) explicitly names Pro-427 as the insertion site in the external loop between TM11 and TM12 (paper's TM numbering). Python confirms seq[426]='P' (position 427) and that position 427 falls within the computed extracellular span 419-431. residue_before=P (pos 427), residue_after=V (pos 428). Distance from TM10 end (418): 9 residues; distance from TM11 start (432): 5 residues — both ≥3 residues from TM boundaries. The 13-aa loop (419-431) is at the lower end of comfortable for a ~15-23 aa tag but the paper demonstrates physical tolerance of the HA insertion. However, uptake was selectively impaired (binding preserved), so this site is ranked lower as function_perturbed. The paper's TM11/12 nomenclature maps to our computed TM10/11 (398-418 / 432-452); position 427 is unambiguously extracellular in both numbering schemes. HA epitope tag inserted at Pro-427 in the extracellular loop between TM11 and TM12 (paper's numbering; ECL 419-431 in computed topology) of full-length human SLC19A1 fused to C-terminal eGFP; expressed in mammalian cells and tested for methotrexate binding and uptake. The insertion selectively interfered with uptake but not binding, indicating partial functional disruption. [validation: function_perturbed; position: validated; source: paper; entailment_verified: True]

sources.claim: The insertion into the cytoplasmic loop between transmembrane regions 10 and 11 (Gln-385) greatly reduced both binding and uptake of methotrexate, whereas the insertion into the external loop between transmembrane regions 11 and 12 (Pro-427) selectively interfered with uptake but not binding.

literature_notes: Six ledger-supported insertion sites were evaluated. Only two are on the extracellular face: Pro-297 (ECL 289-307, TM7-8 loop) and Pro-427 (ECL 419-431, TM10-11 loop). The remaining four — Pro-20 (intracellular N-terminus, residues 1-27), Ser-225 (intracellular loop 6-7, residues 204-268), Gly-492 (intracellular C-terminus, residues 453-591), and Gln-385 (computed as TM residue 363-385, and paper reports 'greatly reduced binding and uptake') — are all intracellular or transmembrane and were excluded. The C-terminal HA tags from PMID 9767079 and PMC13331525 are on the intracellular C-terminus (residues 453-591) and were excluded. The BRIL N-terminal fusion and anti-Fab C-terminal fusion from PMC11965291 are both on the intracellular face (N-terminus of TM1 = cytoplasmic entry; C-terminus of TM12 = cytoplasmic exit) and were excluded. Asn-58 in ECL 49-67 is a known N-glycosylation site (PMID 9767079 mutated it to Gln to study deglycosylation); no insertion was reported there, so no site is proposed. The ECL 114-120 (7 aa), ECL 178-184 (7 aa), and ECL 357-362 (6 aa) loops have no ledger-supported insertions and are not proposed.
